columns.title: Bus Routes Content Section jankipuram
columns.content:
Rules of Transport

◈ School bus routes are drawn up based on convenience and demand while ensuring that no route is overly long.
◈ Parents should consult the School’s Transport In-charge for necessary details or any changes desired.
◈ Under no circumstances are students allowed to go behind or under the buses parked in the school campus and are also not allowed to sit in parked buses during school hours
◈ Under no circumstances should students touch the instrument panel of the buses.
◈ The student has to be on the correct side of the arriving bus.
◈ Students are allowed to use only their allotted bus and bus stop.
◈ Parents are not allowed to enter the bus under any circumstances.
◈ Parents must send an application addressed to the Bus In-charge in case the child is not boarding the bus at home time.
◈ Parents must inform the Office Transport In-charge Mr. Vipin or the Transport Manager Mr. Shashikant Yadav if there is any change in the schedule of their ward commuting by bus
◈ In case if a child is not boarding the bus on a particular day, then the information must be written to Mr. Shashikant Yadav otherwise the responsibility shall not be borne by the school
◈ It is the responsibility of the parent to reach the bus stop well in time to pick up their ward. The Driver and Conductor shall not leave the bus to pick or drop the child

sections.title: Bus Routes Section jankipuram
sections.content:
◈ For the children commuting through private vehicles, the school owes no responsibility outside the campus. Commuting by two wheelers is strictly not allowed by the school administration.
◈ The students must abstain from boarding a running bus to avoid accidents
◈ Parents who want to avail School Transport facility for their ward must contact the Transport In-charge Mr. Vipin or Transport Manager Mr. Shashikant Yadav at the school office during the working hours for details
◈ The school owes no responsibility for the students who are availing the facility of private vans
